answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to stake a refundable deposit in a shared grove of escrowed funds before trading. Newcomers begin in a probationary haven with capped volume, graduating to full limits only after a history of honest attestations. Creating many fake identities then means locking real capital in each one, so the tide of cheap sockpuppets is priced out: attackers pay per identity and forfeit the stake when peers detect fraud.
